* *Mending fishing nets is a vital community effort to ensure sustainable fishing practices.*  
* *Local fishermen and volunteers work together to repair and reuse nets, reducing waste and preserving marine resources.*  
* *The community has established a cistern to store and manage the repaired nets efficiently.*  
* *A trestle is used to support the nets during the mending process, ensuring safety and effectiveness.*  
* *This initiative fosters unity and environmental responsibility among all community members.*
